note: Rewriting styled-components, Emotion and vanilla-extract imports keeps type-only imports type-only: `import { type DefaultTheme, ThemeProvider }` now leaves `import type { DefaultTheme }` on the package instead of a value import that made it a runtime dependency, and an `import type` declaration is left as written. `spin.getName()` on a `keyframes()` binding becomes the generated keyframes name instead of a call on a string that threw at runtime
